clinical_diagnosis_basis.value: Whole-exome sequencing of peripheral blood (MyGenostics, Beijing, China) found a heterozygous TNFAIP3 frameshift variant; Sanger sequencing found no mutation in either parent; classified pathogenic per ACMG (PVS1, PS2, PM2)

parental_testing_statement.value: The Sanger sequencing of their parents for pedigree verification is shown in Figure 4.
